description: Checks a card for coherence: schema completeness, mechanical red flags (generic filler, repeats, want = need, thin core) and a coherence interview built from the card's own content that tests every causal link back to the core. Pass either a draft card (same shape as character_save's card) or the id of a saved one.

card.description: A complete draft card, same shape as character_save's card.

id.description: Or: id of a saved character.

name: character_check
title: Check character coherence
